scientific_limitations: Discrete-time nearest-neighbor no-holding chains, two absorbing endpoints, reset to initial site after nonabsorbing steps; universal lower bound for two extrema, but no general higher-state classification. The twelve-state example itself predates the minimality assertion. Historical-priority risk in unlocated earlier literature.
title: Twelve states are the sharp threshold for two geometric-reset splitting extrema
